description: Preferred structured discovery. Filter by category, partial colour name or required supported width/drop in mm. Returns results containing product_id, name, category and product_url, plus total. Width/drop filters check separate maximums, not every combination; confirm the exact pair with get_price.

colour.description: Partial colour name to match, e.g. "white".

max_height_mm.description: Only products that can be made at least this high (drop), in millimetres. Checked separately from max_width_mm; confirm the exact pair with get_price.

max_width_mm.description: Only products that can be made at least this wide, in millimetres. Checked separately from max_height_mm, not as a pair.

name: lookup_catalog
